notes: «ح» splits two routes; «قالا حدثنا» after the second branch's co-transmitters writes عمرو بن مرة, ابن أبي ليلى, البراء once for both, so they are the shared tail
the first branch's own عن عمرو بن مرة before the ح is the same name as the tail's first link and is carried by the tail
«وقال عبيد الله أن رسول الله» is a wording remark from the same transmitter, not a route
